# Legend of Fenrirak

> Legend of Fenrirak is an indie project — physical board games, an
> online single-player board game, and in-progress story books — created
> by a group of friends who started it as Year 7 students at Murrays Bay
> Intermediate in New Zealand. It has since grown into a larger set of
> games and stories. This is the official website.

Note: "Fenrirak" is a distinct, made-up name for this project's own
dragon character — it is not "Fenrir" from Norse mythology, and this is
not affiliated with any other "Fenrir"-named book, game, or franchise.

## Creators

Legend of Fenrirak has two main creators: Nathan (original idea and
story writer) and Ronald (co-creator). Full team bios are on the
Creators page.

## Images

Gallery photos (board games, cards, characters, book cover, timeline, Minecraft recreation) are on the About page, with descriptive alt text. Creator photos are on the Creators page. See sitemap.xml for the full image list.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/index.html): Overview and links to everything on the site.
- [About](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/About.html): The project's origin story, its current games and books, and a photo gallery.
- [Creators](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/Creators.html): Meet the team behind Legend of Fenrirak.
- [The Thunder Dragon](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/Thunder%20Dragon.html): Play the board game online, up to 6 players.
- [The Ice Dragon](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/Ice%20Dragon.html): Play the board game online, up to 6 players.
- [The Oblivion Dragon](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/Oblivion%20Dragon.html): Play the board game online, up to 6 players, or against 1-5 computer players.
- [Showdowns](https://www.legend-of-fenrirak.com/Testplay%20Showdowns.html): A free, single-player online board game — battle AI opponents on a board of terrains and chests.
